amendments.reason: Clearing the cache entry for an etag-less pointer would re-fetch and re-emit an unchanged segment every tick, which breaks the phase goal; comparing versions keeps the dedupe. A segment that was loaded but becomes unreadable keeps its last copy, matching FlagClient last-known-good (decisions.md horizon 15).

changes.before: If a pointer has no etag, clear that key's cache entry, mirroring the loaded=undefined handling.
changes.after: If a pointer has no etag, keep the cache entry with etag undefined and dedupe on version; a failed read keeps the last loaded copy and is retried next tick.

dimensions.evidence: deliver() falls through to refreshSegments on unchanged snapshot and emits once; snapshot-change path emits once from loadVersion; push tests assert exactly-once for segment-only, combined, and no-change cases.

IfNoneMatch=cached etag on conditional reads, none on reconcile/push; same version only updates etag; tests assert IfNoneMatch, pointer-only reads over 3 ticks, reconcile without header, etag-less dedupe per amendment, load reuse.
Every tick re-reads all segmentKeys so failed keys retry; recovery, last-good retention and pruning of unreferenced keys each covered by a test.

Re-graded after healer fix: push and tick share serially() and deliver(); new test holds the poll's segment GET, fires a push, asserts no emission before release, exact emission sequence and a single staff/2.json GET.
